purpose: AnatomyCarve is a 3D Slicer extension that enables interactive GPU-accelerated volumetric carving and visualization of medical images using custom compute shaders and segmentation masks.

safety.rationale: Inspected Python logic, UI, and C++ source files. No hardcoded secrets, no arbitrary code execution or unsafe deserialization, no unauthorized telemetry or external network calls. PyOpenGL import uses standard slicer.util.pip_install fallback.

environment.rationale: No changes to Slicer's shared environment, no package installation at startup or import, no pins/downgrades of bundled packages. PyOpenGL is lazily imported/installed on demand via slicer.util.pip_install only when PyOpenGL is missing.

packaging.rationale: CMake configuration correctly builds and registers scripted and loadable modules, and all Python scripts and resources are accounted for.

license.rationale: Apache License 2.0 is provided in LICENSE.txt, permitting distribution.

soundness.rationale: Follows Slicer ScriptedLoadableModule architecture and parameter node wrappers correctly. Observers are cleaned up on widget destruction, and errors are handled robustly.

utility.rationale: Includes clear documentation links, sample data registration, widget testing setup, and a helpful user description.

not_checked: Building and running the extension inside a full 3D Slicer runtime with active GPU compute shader support (Windows/Linux)
